description: This Java class defines a fragment for the settings UI of the AnySoftKeyboard app, specifically handling effects-related preferences such as power save mode, night mode, vibration, and navigation bar colorization. It manages preference interactions and visibility based on Android SDK version.

classes.name: EffectsSettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment managing the effects settings UI, including navigation to other settings screens and adjusting preferences visibility based on Android version.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Initializes preferences from the specified XML resource.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up preference click listeners and visibility based on Android SDK version.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title to 'effects group' when the fragment starts.
